claim_boundary: ISA-level execution of the encoded full-shape TP-4 layer-20 program on four ranks (program dataflow, addresses, strides, counts, DYN, constants, collectives) against the released-checkpoint golden on synthetic golden-consistent KV state. Weight-engine arithmetic is the golden's on the rank's image slice; no engine microarchitecture, RTL, cycle or physical verdict.

fixes.old: weights_proj split by output rows (8 head weights a rank) while the head-weight op and the index score read all 32
fixes.new: weights_proj replicated per rank (32 x 5120 BF16, 320 KB; deviation from the model's output split)

fixes.old: an XU SELECT over the selected indices (no scores, no global ids)
fixes.new: local top-NSL1 + selected scores + COLL_TOPK_MERGE (global id = rank * SC1 + local id) to SELG

fixes.old: row selector NC1 (= pos + 1): one past the golden's appended key
fixes.new: row POS (global key id of the position)

fixes.old: CROM base 0 placeholders for compressor.norm and indexer.k_norm
the rank's 128 latent rows normalised alone
fixes.new: BF16 rows all-gathered to 512 (COLL ALL_GATHER) before the RMS norm

fixes.where: candidate blocks (ESTIMATED SU max + XU select)
fixes.old: no pin of the newest block, a select over the die's blocks only
fixes.new: per-rank block max, NEWBLK pin (+inf, rank-aware DYN), local top-2048, COLL_TOPK_MERGE (stride ceil(SC1/8)) to CAND

fixes.old: local SEL ids into the VM CKV region
fixes.new: global SELG ids of the HBM compressed store (a_base 0, a_so 512)

fixes.old: read BLK[NEWBLK] -- the never-written pad slot on the three non-owner ranks (unwritten VM read; verdict fail with every region bit-exact)
fixes.new: operand from WTS[0] (finite): finite + inf = +inf; the op never reads the pad slot
full-profile field coll_d_stride at the fixed offset 2042 (6 bits, clear of W11's appended fusion fields); FULL_DYN NEWBLK (slot 52)

inputs.window_rows_check: re-derived from the seed (the reference record pins only the whole-state digest); checked through the bit-exact attention output

headline: 1048576_seed20260930_L20

descriptor.coll_src: n scores, FP32 VM elements (BF16-valued index scores; candidate block maxima or +inf for the pinned block)
descriptor.coll_ibase: n local ids, u32 bit patterns in FP32 VM containers, ascending (an XU SELECT output); score i belongs to id i
descriptor.coll_n: n, static, a multiple of 16 (512 index, 2048 candidate)
descriptor.coll_d_stride: DYN selector (FULL profile field appended at offset 1961, 6 bits): global id = rank * dyn[coll_d_stride] + local id (SC1 for the index, ceil(SC1/8) for the candidate blocks)
descriptor.coll_dst: k global ids, u32, one per VM element (16 per word), ascending, on every rank

COLL_TOPK_MERGE.order: (score descending, global id ascending) over the 4n pairs; values compared as reals: -0 == +0 (canonicalise before an order-preserving u32 map), -inf the least value, no masking
COLL_TOPK_MERGE.golden: hdc_golden_v41.topk_lowest_index over the global score array, then sorted
COLL_TOPK_MERGE.padding: entries past a rank's live count must hold -inf (not emitted: the program's contexts have SC1 >= 512 and >= 2048 blocks; n_pos >= 65,533)
COLL_TOPK_MERGE.zeros: no -0 reaches these regions (csum from +0, zero-canonicalising adds); canonicalise anyway
COLL_TOPK_MERGE.status: the die faults coll_op[1] today (rtl/chip/ot_chip_v41x_die.sv coll_issue_bad)

DYN.NEWBLK: FULL_DYN slot 52, rank-aware: owner = (NC1 - 1) // SC1; on the owner rank ((NC1 - 1) - RANK * SC1) // 8, else ceil(SC1 / 8) (a pad slot one past the rank's last block)
DYN.coll_d_stride: the core resolves the DYN selector into the collective request like any DYN field

contract.key_partition: contiguous quarters: rank r's index keys are global rows [r * SC1, (r + 1) * SC1), SC1 = ceil(NC1 / 4); the fused index op's row r is global key r * SC1 + r
contract.stores: the index-key write (SU KVT, 128 wide) is global key row POS; the compressed-row write (QE QDQ4E, element address row * 512) is global row POS; the selected-row gather (SU a_ind IND_O into KV/KVT, a_base 0, a_so 512) reads global compressed rows by id -- HBM stores, not the vector memory
contract.deviation: indexer weights_proj replicated per rank (32 x 5120 BF16, 320 KB) instead of the model's output split: the exact head sum needs all 32 head weights on every rank
